name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Price List
notes: Oracle's own price list, and unusually it prices GPU shapes PER GPU PER HOUR rather than per instance. AI/ML section: BM.GPU.H100.8 = $10.00 per GPU per hour; BM.GPU.H200.8 = $10.00; BM.GPU.A100-v2.8 (8x A100 80GB) = $4.00; BM.GPU4.8 (8x A100 40GB) = $3.05; BM.GPU.L40S-NC.4 = $3.50; BM.GPUA10.4 / VM.GPU.A10.1 = $2.00; BM.GPU3.8 (V100 16GB) = $2.95; VM.GPU2.1 (P100) = $1.275. Block Volume and Object Storage both $0.0255/GB/month. IMPORTANT currency caveat: the page renders live in the reader's selected currency and defaults to USD on a US IP; the figures above were read with USD selected.
